policy.process: Feature Intake -> Feature Build -> Feature Done Definition -> Risk-based Test Selection -> Release Gate
policy.windowsQaRule: Only windows-qa-server + real-gpu + actual-user-operation with official summary fields is accepted as official AT/Release Gate visual evidence.
policy.localRule: local-windows and WSLg results are diagnostic/supporting only unless explicitly promoted by a later WindowsQA Server run.
policy.xvfbPolicy: Xvfb/CPU fallback is not accepted as real GPU evidence.
policy.testExpansionPolicy: Human-readable test-matrix uses representative guarantee items. Detailed tests are linked through test-inventory and manifest commands.
policy.bugRegressionPolicy: Producer/QA-reported bugs are tracked in bug-regressions.md and must link back to canonical test_id entries. Open release-blocking bug regressions block Release Gate.

gateRules.requiredPass: Gate=required requires Result=PASS with evidence registered in this manifest.
gateRules.officialVisualEvidence: ST/AT items that verify Windows visual UX require windows-qa-server + real-gpu + actual-user-operation evidence.
gateRules.supportingNotSubstitute: supporting and diagnostic runs cannot substitute required ST/AT evidence.
gateRules.diagnosticOnly: PASS_WITH_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY is never a Release Gate PASS.
gateRules.secretEvidence: Evidence containing secrets, tokens, cookies, API keys, or PII is invalid unless redacted.
gateRules.officialSummaryFields: Official WindowsQA evidence requires official=true, mode/executionMode=official, sourceMode=git, requestedCommit, resolvedCommit, cleanChecks, skippedSteps, schemaVersion, qaProfile, runnerScriptSha256, and must not set officialPassEligible=false, officialEvidenceValid=false, headlessDiagnosticAllowed=true, or headlessDetected=true. Legacy official summaries without newer compatibility fields are warning-only if official/sourceMode/commit/clean/skippedSteps checks pass.
gateRules.exactRevision: Official WindowsQA must pin an exact commit. Branch-tip-only execution is diagnostic/supporting.
gateRules.packagingGate: Release Gate requires packaged release build or installer execution evidence; dev server/debug build evidence cannot substitute it.
gateRules.qaRefForUncommittedWork: Uncommitted work should be tested through a pushed refs/qa/<run-id> commit. Source snapshots remain diagnostic/supporting only.
gateRules.abortedRun: ABORTED runs are recorded but never counted as PASS. Required test ids remain NOT_RUN unless a complete official run passes.
gateRules.runSpecificEvidence: Release Gate evidence must reference runId-specific immutable paths and hashes. latest-* aliases are convenience only and are not valid manifest evidence.
gateRules.invalidSummary: Missing, incomplete, or runId/zip-mismatched summaries are invalid evidence.
gateRules.requiredBlockedBlocksRelease: Any test id listed in requiredBlocked blocks Release Gate. requiredBlocked is never a waiver, scope exclusion, or partial PASS.
gateRules.mockNotSubstituteForRealLlm: Deterministic mock app-tool evidence can verify routing but cannot substitute ORB-AT-001 real LLM representative evidence.
gateRules.packagingPartialProgressNotPass: For ORB-GATE-002, SSH, clean checkout, or partial precheck success is not Release Packaging PASS. Release build, installer install, installed app startup, uninstall, and cleanup evidence are required.
gateRules.notRunDependency: ORB-GATE-001 remains NOT_RUN when upstream required items are blocked; this is intentional dependency gating, not a passing or waived state.
gateRules.releasePassAudit: Release approval must run audit-release-manifest with --require-release-pass. Any requiredBlocked, requiredNotRun, or nonVerifiedBlockingBugs item makes Release Gate fail.
gateRules.passArtifactPinning: Release Gate PASS evidence must use runId-specific immutable summary and artifact zip paths. latest-* aliases are allowed only as convenience or FAIL/BLOCKED diagnostic evidence, never as PASS or release approval evidence.

bugRegressionRules.unlinkedBug: A bug regression without linked_test_ids is not accepted for Release Gate.
bugRegressionRules.unverifiedFix: A fixed bug without verification_evidence remains fixed_pending_verification.
bugRegressionRules.bugSpecificVerification: A bug can be verified when its own reproduction condition has official or accepted supporting evidence, even if the linked test_id remains PASS_WITH_LIMITATION or NOT_RUN for broader acceptance scope.

waiverRules.default: No waiver is active unless explicitly listed under waivers.

waivers.reason: Discord test environment is not prepared for this run. Producer explicitly instructed to proceed with all remaining work except Discord.
waivers.releaseGateMeaning: Scope deferral only. Does not count as PASS for Discord real relay and does not validate Discord send/receive or queue metrics.
waivers.recheckCondition: Before a release that includes Discord relay as in-scope, run ORB-SIT-002 real Discord relay evidence on WindowsQA or a dedicated Discord-ready QA environment.
